complete_examples.text: Considering the tunnel dislocation in the active fault zone, a deformation mapping method to achieve the displacement transmission from the soil to the track and tunnel structures is presented, and then the influence of fault dislocation, considering train speed, single- and double-train operation, on system dynamic performance has been calculated and analyzed.

Single- and double-line operation on tunnel responses To clarify the influence of single- and double-train operation on system vibrations, two running conditions are set as: a single train moving through the tunnel, represented as C1, two trains moving through the tunnel against each other, and meeting at the tunnel center, represented as C2, and two trains moving through the tunnel in the same direction on parallel tracks, represented as C3.
